relNote: Legal entity configuration record — one row per company (DataAreaId) in the D365FO instance. Stores company name, registration numbers, VAT ID, address, and primary contact information.

def.name: CompanyInfo
def.description: Legal entity master record — one row per company in a D365FO deployment. Holds the company name, DataAreaId (company account), primary postal address, VAT registration number, and contact details. Referenced by Ledger and all transaction tables via DataAreaId.

fields.name: DataArea
fields.note: Primary identifier (company account / DataAreaId) for this legal entity

fields.name: PartyNumber
fields.note: Global address book party number for this legal entity

fields.name: VATNum
fields.note: VAT registration number for this legal entity

fields.name: LanguageId
fields.note: Default language code for the company (e.g. 'en-us')

fields.name: PrimaryAddressLocation
fields.note: FK to the primary postal address record

fields.name: BranchId
fields.note: Business segment / branch identifier for reporting

fields.name: OrgId
fields.note: Organization ID used in inter-company scenarios

relNote: Generic operating unit table — used as financial dimension values for BusinessUnit, Department, CostCenter, and similar org unit types. OMOperatingUnitNumber is the user-visible code shown in dimension lookups.

def.name: OMOperatingUnit
def.description: Operating unit (business unit, department, cost centre, retail channel) master. Acts as the dimension value source for organisational financial dimensions. OMOperatingUnitType enum distinguishes the unit type: BusinessUnit, Department, CostCenter, RetailChannel, Warehouse.

fields.name: OMOperatingUnitNumber
fields.note: User-visible code for this operating unit (appears in dimension value lookups)

fields.name: Name
fields.note: Display name of the operating unit

fields.name: OMOperatingUnitType
fields.note: Enum: 1 = BusinessUnit, 2 = Department, 3 = CostCenter, 4 = RetailChannel, 5 = Warehouse — determines which financial dimension this unit belongs to

fields.name: PartyNumber
fields.note: Global address book party number for this org unit

fields.name: NameAlias
fields.note: Short alias for the operating unit

fields.name: PrimaryAddressLocation
fields.note: FK to the primary postal address for this unit

fields.name: HcmWorker
fields.note: FK to the manager (HCM Worker) responsible for this operating unit
